reconciled.title: An apparent contradiction explained by context

examples.rationale: The facts refer to different timeframes: Fact A covers the first half of the fiscal year 2025 (April to September 2024), while Fact B covers the calendar year 2024. Because the periods are not identical, the difference in values does not constitute a contradiction. Supporting words: “Fact A: "In H1 of FY25"; Fact B: "in 2024"”

detail.rule_rationale: The reporting windows only partially overlap: FY2025 partially overlaps 2024.
